claims.text: "Inflammatory phenotype" (fever, ↑CRP and/or inflam on ♡ MRI): IL-1 inhibitors (eg, anakinra, rilonacept) are preferred as second-line tx.
claims.quote: For patients with an "inflammatory phenotype," with fever, elevated C-reactive protein (CRP), and/or inflammation seen on cardiac MRI, interleukin-1 (IL-1) inhibitors (eg, anakinra, rilonacept, goflikicept) are preferred as second-line therapy

claims.text: Rilonacept (Arcalyst): FDA-labeled for recurr pericarditis and ↓risk of recurr.
claims.quote: treatment of recurrent pericarditis (RP) and reduction in risk of recurrence
